lines.t: Dark is heavy, but I hear a whisper in the room
Thought I was forgotten, buried deep inside the gloomster
Looking backward, staring at the damage and the loss
Trapped in my own head, forgetting what you did up on the cross
Then you cut through the noise, saying, daughter, get up
Put your feet on the ground, look at me begin again
You're no longer bound
Every chain of my shame, watch it shatter on the floor
I ain't living in the shadows of my past anymore
So I fix my gaze on you, my beloved
I close my ears to the accuser's voice
My past is gone, washed away in your love
As far as east from west, I make my choice
I leave the old behind
Buried in the grave
You set me free
And Lord, I am saved
Yesterday is dead and gone
Tomorrow's got no hold on me
Washed in the water, now I'm walking in the victory
You caught me, step back in line
Put your hand in mine
We walking side by side, child
It's your time to shine
Learning how to reject the fate
Choose what is good
Standing firm in the power where your grace always stood
No more enemy whispers trying to throw me off track
Got my armor strapped tight and I ain't looking back
So I fix my gaze on you, my beloved
I close my hands to the accuser's voice
My past is gone, washed away in your love
As far as east from west, I'll make my choice
I leave the old behind
Buried in the grave, you set me free
And Lord, I am saved
Heavy laden, exhausted
Carrying weight that wasn't mine
Trying to fight my own battles
Running way out of line
Then I took your yoke
Found your heart wasn't mine
Gentle, lowly
Calling me your child
My soul finds rest in who you are
Safe inside your light, no longer fall
Your yoke is easy, your burden is light
Walking with you straight into the morning light
Forgiven, restored, truly free
Forever beginning again
Can we be
Forever beginning again
Set free
Thanks for watching!
